name: BLT Demo User
bio: Bug hunter and open-source security contributor. Part of the OWASP BLT project.

questions.involvement: I am a full-time security researcher focused on web application vulnerabilities. I contribute to OWASP BLT by discovering and reporting bugs across open-source projects, helping maintainers ship more secure software.
questions.evolution: Cybersecurity is shifting toward AI-assisted threat detection and automated patch management. I believe open-source collaboration — communities like OWASP — will be the cornerstone of keeping the internet safe as attack surfaces grow exponentially.
questions.achievement: Discovered a critical authentication bypass in a widely-used open-source CMS affecting over 50,000 installations. Coordinated responsible disclosure with the maintainer team and authored the CVE writeup, which was featured in multiple security publications.

pr_list.title: Fix XSS vulnerability in comment parser
Add CSRF protection to profile endpoint
Improve rate limiting on login API

monthly_report.top_finding: Stored XSS in markdown renderer — CVE-2024-XXXXX
